README/CHANGELOG already describe this accurately -- no doc drift found. Flipped both checkboxes in EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 551 to [x] and closed the section except for the one real, named-deferred item (BotPerm/etc, waiting on D4).

title: SECTION 551 backlog bookkeeping closed: D2 auto-release + IDUNA signing confirmed live
